latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of aipose-openapi-skill version 1.0.0
- Enables changing a human pose in a photo while preserving the garment
- Provides endpoints to start a pose change run, poll status, and upload images
- Requires HTTPS connection to openapi.weshop.ai and a valid API key via WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable
- Users must not share their API key with domains other than openapi.weshop.ai
- Supports adjustable generation quality and batch output options
